hypothesis: Apply the already frozen arithmetic models to new synthetic operator rows on physical Metal
decisionRule: For each fixed arithmetic model, require every element of a row to match one common allowed inverseSqrt estimate, bit-for-bit. Report how many complete rows each fixed model explains. Never choose a different model per output element.
referenceRule: Compare retained high-precision proxy to an independent RMSNorm evaluation; this is diagnostic and does not activate another model reference.
negativeControls: Change one output of each row by 0.01
Use the wrong normalization weight offset
limitations: Synthetic operator inputs, not held-out prompts
Physical Metal; no AMD operator rerun
